name: What happens after the roof damage assessment is completed?

mainEntity.name: What happens after the roof damage assessment is completed?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the roof damage assessment, our inspector will review the findings with you, explain any identified issues, and present a detailed report. This report will include photographic evidence and a recommended course of action, whether it's minor repairs or a full roof replacement. We will then provide a transparent estimate for the proposed work, allowing you to understand the next steps and make an informed decision without obligation.
acceptedAnswer.description: After assessment, we review findings, present a detailed report with recommendations, and provide a transparent estimate for proposed work.
